findings.detail: The 15484880 Canada Inc. and 15484910 Canada Inc. senior subordinated loan is stored with blank interest_rate even though the source coupon is 14.00% PIK.

rationale: X02 flags private credit rows with no interest_rate or basis_spread. The raw schedule block for 15484880 Canada Inc. and 15484910 Canada Inc. shows the continuation row for the senior subordinated loan with Coupon 14.00 % PIK and maturity 04/2035, matching the flagged holding with fair value 13,520.1 thousand, while the extracted issue value is blank. That is a source-grounded missing-rate extraction gap.
